description: Source paths that exist in both schema_forge_core and schema_forge (ETP-4980). `divergent`: copies that already drifted, NOT yet consolidated; each needs an owner decision and a call-site migration, never a whole-file copy. Each side is pinned by sha256: any further change fails the check and forces a reviewed update of this file. `identical`: copies still byte-equal; core is the owner and the schema_forge copy is deleted once it consumes the published package. `moved`: the module now lives in core's published CLI package; the copy still at that path in schema_forge must match it (report-i18n import aside) until schema_forge drops it. Remove an entry when its file is consolidated; the check fails on stale entries. DO NOT run `make sync-report-helpers` in schema_forge until its helper copies are removed: it would recreate templates/reports/helpers/ and parity.json in core.

cli/src/db.js.reason: divergent API: core adds sweepCache/getCacheDrift/reportCacheDrift/resolveCacheDir/applyCacheModeFromEnv and renames DEFAULT_CACHE_PATH to DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR; schema_forge call sites must migrate

cli/src/data-fixes/run.js.reason: divergent: schema_forge has features core lacks and vice versa; needs owner decision

identical.cli/src/data-fixes/lib/sampledata-xml.js: owner: core (ships in the CLI package). schema_forge has no caller; its copy is deleted in the schema_forge change
identical.scripts/etp-4177-tax-migration/gen-obtl-: one-off ETP-4177 migration; core is the single owner, the schema_forge copy is deleted in the schema_forge change
identical.scripts/run-sequence-generator-cloud.mjs: core owns it (has the unit test); the schema_forge copy is deleted in the schema_forge change
identical.scripts/selector-inventory.js: core owns it (has the unit test); the schema_forge copy is deleted in the schema_forge change

templates/reports/helpers/report-html-he.reason: moved to the published CLI package; schema_forge keeps its copy until it imports the package
